text:
alex_k: Heads-up — vendor says a partial RMA air shipment (20 H100s) will clear FRA customs earliest Mon, ETA to our EU depot Tue. Need decision: accept partial air vs wait for full sea batch in ~2 weeks to avoid split AWBs and extra brokerage.

maria_g: If we accept air split we pay ~€2.2k/unit uplift incl. brokerage. Sea saves ~€1.6k/unit but delays capacity by ~14 days.

pete_ops: What's our urgent demand? Dedicated pool has 120 queued jobs, 20% failing SLO. Can we deprioritize non-critical tenants?

suresh_s: We can shift dev sandbox traffic to lower-grade quantized instances for 10 days. That frees ~30 H100-equivalent capacity. Cost tradeoff: compute > shipping? quick math below.

alex_k: @suresh_s show numbers please.

suresh_s: quick calc: air uplift = 20 units * €2200 = €44,000. Quantization + preemption -> estimated extra infra cost €6,000 over 2 weeks. So paying for air nets an incremental spend of ~€38k to get capacity now. If revenue / penalty from SLO breaches > €38k we should air.

maria_g: Customer Success flagged 2 enterprise customers at risk of failover if tail latency >120ms for more than 6hrs. Estimated churn/penalty ~€50–80k. That pushes us towards air.

pete_ops: Operational note: vendor requires RMA manifest signed and serials swapped on arrival. Depot can do onsite swaps but capacity is capped at 12 swaps/day — 20 units -> spread across 2 days unless we add temp staff.

alex_k: @lee_from_supply can you confirm whether you can consolidate AWBs at origin to reduce fees and paperwork? Also confirm eta variance and if they can pre-clear to our EORI.

lee_from_supply: We can consolidate to a single AWB at origin but customs treat bulk differently depending on docs. Consolidation reduces paperwork by ~€1.1k but won't eliminate customs brokerage on split manifests. We can pre-clear to Redwood EORI which typically shaves 6–12 hours off release. ETA variance +/- 1 day.

pete_ops: Ops plan draft: receive Tue evening, depot swaps Wed-Thu, burn-in and tests Fri, EU-dedicated pool online Sat AM. Canary rollout to 10% traffic Fri night then 100% Sat midday.

maria_g: Approvals: finance (maria_g) ok to fund air uplift pending exec sign-off. @alex_k please escalate to exec for fast PO. I'll prep PO draft.

alex_k: Will ping @cto and attach the numbers.

deploy-bot: PO created #PO-7893 draft by maria_g (status: pending exec approval)

suresh_s: One technical ask — schedule KV-cache warmers and prefix caching pre-rollout. Without warmers first ~30k tokens will spike latency and trigger alerts.

pete_ops: Noted. I'll schedule rolling warmers + trace collection and add a short-lived metric guard: if p95 > 150ms abort canary.

alex_k: Decision: exec approved at 1715678945, PO signed. Proceed with air shipment + consolidation + depot swap. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

pete_ops: Final checklist I will track: inbound AWB, customs pre-clear, depot staff booking (two-day swap), signed swap manifest, warmers scheduled, canary routing config, SLO monitors + alerting. I'll post the checklist in #eng-ops and tag ops on updates.

lee_from_supply: Sending updated manifest and AWB numbers now. Will flag if any customs hold shows up.

maria_g: I'll upload PO and cost breakdown to finance drive and link in thread.

alex_k: Closing loop — air ship + RMA swap approved. Keep updates short in thread, escalate if customs hits.
